exclusion_reason: PWA/offline install is implemented: the emitter writes a service worker that precaches every content-addressed chunk by hash, a web manifest, and an app shell that registers the worker; because each cache key is a content hash, the precache diff invalidates exactly the changed block. The benchmark stays red because reaching interactive fully offline from the cache needs the absent browser game runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the offline run reaches interactive from hash-verified chunk and the update invalidates exactly the changed set.
active_gate_evidence: test/package.test.mjs asserts the service worker precaches every chunk hash, the shell registers the worker, and computePrecacheDiff invalidates exactly the changed block while retaining the rest.
procedure: Update one chunk and assert only it invalidates.
